name: Neon Chess
tagline: Real chess in a cyberpunk plaza — Overlords, Mechs and Street Runners fight it out on every capture.

modes.name: Blitz
modes.description: 5 minutes on the clock for each side. Type !join to play — the first two take the seats, a bot fills an empty one.

modes.name: Duel the Streamer
modes.description: The streamer plays Cyan with 5 minutes each. Type !join to enter the draw: one random challenger plays Magenta.

modes.name: Rapid
modes.description: 10 minutes on the clock for each side, for a proper game.

modes.name: Chat vs Streamer
modes.description: The streamer plays Cyan, and chat votes on every Magenta move: first the piece, then the square. No clock.

modes.name: Relaxed
modes.description: No clock — 90 seconds per step; if time runs out, the bot makes that move.

commands.help: pick a piece (numbers on the board), then !1 … to pick its square
mods: switch mode in the lobby

howTo: Normal chess rules. Cyan moves first.
Pick a piece with its number (!3), then the square it goes to (!7) — or type the move: !e4, !Nf3, !O-O.
Captures turn into battles: every piece has its own attack.
Checkmate wins. Watch your clock: out of time loses.
